The files in this folder do **not** state what the club paid for water in 2025.

Here is what the files do contain on the subject of water bills and related utility costs:

* **2025 water bill:** In the 8 September 2026 minutes ([Meeting sept 8.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/Meeting%20sept%208.md#L15-L16)), it notes that Paolo said the 2026 water bill so far ($312.40) was *"a little under last year's pace,"* but that he *"did not have last year's figure with him."*
* **2026 water bill:**
  * As of 8 September 2026, the 2026 water bill so far was **$312.40** ([Meeting sept 8.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/Meeting%20sept%208.md#L15-L16)).
  * By 3 November 2026, the total water bill for 2026 came to **$486.75** ([Nov 3 (final).md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/Nov%203%20(final).md#L18)).
* **2025 electricity bill (for comparison):** The 11 August 2026 minutes mention that the 2025 electricity bill for the shed lights was **$96.20** for the whole year ([aug11.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/aug11.md#L8-L9)).
* **Other water-related notes:** The minutes also cover requests to the city to add a second tap at the far end of the plots ([aug11.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/aug11.md#L11-L12), [notes_2026-09-22.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/notes_2026-09-22.md#L18-L19), [Nov 3 (final).md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/Nov%203%20(final).md#L15-L16)) and adding the winter water shut-off (scheduled for 14 November) to the winter closing checklist ([oct6 meeting notes.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/oct6%20meeting%20notes.md#L13-L15), [Nov 3 (final).md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r1/notes/Nov%203%20(final).md#L13)).
